Para autenticarte, sincronizar tu bóveda: To authenticate you, sync your vault across your devices, allow encrypted sends to your contacts, remind you about expiry dates, adapt the interface to your age, confirm that you are 18 or older, prevent abuse and keep the service secure. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
Usamos cookies necesarias para la sesión: We use cookies required for the session and CSRF protection, and local storage for language, easy mode, large text, trusted device and auto-lock time. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party analytics.
Las llaves se derivan con Argon2id y el: Keys are derived with Argon2id and content is encrypted with XChaCha20-Poly1305 on the client. In production the service must be served over HTTPS. If you enable email recovery, we keep a recoverable copy of the master key and can open a copy of the vault after verifying a code sent to your email. That feature is optional. No system is infallible: keep your emergency key and keep your devices updated.
El servicio es solo para personas de 18: The service is for people aged 18 or older only. We use the date of birth to confirm it and to enable easy mode from age 51. If we change this policy, we will publish the update date and, when the change is relevant, notify you in the app.
Eres responsable de tu contraseña, tu fr: You are responsible for your password, vault phrase, PIN and emergency key. If you enable email recovery, we keep a recoverable copy of the master key and you can open the vault with a code sent to your email; that feature is optional and means the server can help recover the vault. If you do not enable it and you lose your emergency key and forget your phrase, we cannot recover the encrypted content. Do not share your keys with anyone.
Debes tener al menos 18 años para crear: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account and use My Pass. The date of birth you provide must be correct.

My Pass es una bóveda personal para guar: My Pass is a personal vault for storing documents, tickets, cards and passes. Content is encrypted on your device before it leaves it. By default, the server stores encrypted blobs and encrypted metadata; it cannot read your documents or keys. If you enable email recovery, we keep a recoverable copy of the master key for that flow.
